Hi Samantha — thanks for confirming Option B. Looping in the capacity details here so you have a first-pass view before the SOW revision.

Proposed capacity uplift (draft):
- Current committed throughput: 25M tokens / month
- Proposed committed throughput: 60M tokens / month
- Monthly burst pool (on-demand): up to 110M tokens with tiered pricing after 80M
- Expected latency SLO target: 250ms p50, 800ms p95 for < 2s end-to-end requests

Commercial breakdown we'll include in the updated SOW:
- Committed capacity: fixed monthly fee (applies to term).
- Burst usage: priced per token above committed threshold (monthly true-up).
- Optional add-on: higher retention audit logs (30-day vs default 7-day) — note this may add nominal infra fees.

I uploaded a version of the capacity workbook to the shared Drive (link below). It contains simulated billing scenarios for different monthly profiles; Samantha, Olivia — please review the scenarios that match your forecast and flag which tier you'd expect.

Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cClearbridgeKickoff

David, can you confirm whether we need legal to call out specific encryption-at-rest language (customer-managed keys) in this SOW? If so, we should surface that in the July 6 draft.

Thanks — I’ll prepare the SOW markup and pricing appendix for the July 6 delivery.
